title: 第6章 风雪杀机
content_zh:
秦英豪望着怀里女儿那张甜美秀丽的脸蛋，脑海中浮现起六年前的往事。这件事已经过去六年了，但好像是昨天刚发生一样，一切全清清楚楚。眼前下着倾盆大雨，六年前的那天，下的却是雪，漫山遍野鹅毛般的大雪。

    那是在陕西山阳的鹘岭道路上，时近岁晚，道上行人稀少，秦英豪骑着一匹高头长腿的黄马，控辔北行。十数年前的腊月，他和闵刀王在天竺山大顶峰比武，以毒刀误伤了闵恩仇。闵夫人自刎殉夫。他与闵恩仇武功相当，豪气相投，两人化敌为友，相敬相重，岂知一招之失，竟伤了这位生平唯一知己。他是当世大侠，纵横海内，直到遇上了闵恩仇，才遇上了真正的对手，才真正的肝胆相照。秦英豪为了此事，十二年来始终耿耿于怀，郁郁寡欢。

    闵恩仇夫妇逝世十二年周年将近，秦英豪去年这时曾去祭拜过亡友夫妇之墓，见墓砖有些残破了，拿了些钱叫人修葺。这时左右无事，又千里迢迢从射阳赶来，他要再到亡友夫妇墓前去察看，残破处是否已经修好。风雪残年，马上黄昏，秦英豪越近山阳，心越沉重。他纵马缓行，心中在想：“当年若不是一招失手，今日与闵兄夫妇三骑漫游天下，叫贪官污吏、土豪贼匪，无不心惊胆碎。那是何等快意！”

    正自出神，忽然听到身后车轮压雪，一个司机驾车而行，一辆豪车从白茫茫的雪原上冲风冒雪，疾行而来。大车从秦英豪身旁掠过，忽听一个娇柔的女子声音从车中传了出来：“爸爸，到了维京，你得陪我去各个风景区玩玩儿……”这是江南姑娘极柔极清的语声，在这西北茫茫雪原上，甚不相衬。

    突然，车前轮驶进一个凹槽，顿时向前蹶踬。那司机下车来，托住前厢，随手上提，跟着一跃回到车上，继续驰行。秦英豪暗暗诧异：“司机这一提一跃，好俊的身手，好强的膂力！看来是位风尘奇士，怎么去跑车子了？”

    思算未定，只听脚步声响，后面一个农民工挑了一担行李，迈开大步赶了上来。这担行李压的一根枣木扁担直弯下去，颇为沉重，但那农民工行若无事，在雪地里快步而行，落脚甚轻。秦英豪更加奇怪：“这农民工非但力大，而且轻功了得。”他知道其中必有蹊跷：“这农民工似在追踪前面那车，看来会有凶杀寻仇之事。”当下提着马缰，不疾不徐地遥遥跟在豪车后面，要待看个究竟。

    行出数里，见那农民工虽肩上压着沉重行李，仍奔跑如飞。忽听身后铜片叮叮当当响，一个汉子挑着一副馄饨担子，虚飘飘赶来。这人在雪中行走，落步甚轻，轻功之佳，武林中甚为罕见。秦英豪寻思：“又多了一个。这人是哪一派的？”但见他斗笠和蓑衣上罩满了白雪，在风中一晃一飘，走得歪歪斜斜，顿时想起：“这身轻功是大化所的功夫。”

    行了七八里路，天色黑下来，来到一个小市集。秦英豪见豪车停在一家饭店前面，于是进店借宿。饭店甚小，集上就此一家。客商们都挤在厅上取暖喝酒，司机、农民工、馄饨贩子都在其内。

    秦英豪虽名满天下，但近十年来隐居射阳，武林中认识他的人不多。那司机、农民工、馄饨贩子他都不相识，于是默然坐在一张小桌旁，要了酒饭，见那三人分别喝酒用饭，互不招呼，瞧来似乎并非一路。

    忽听内院一个人大声说：“方主任、方姑娘，小地方委屈点儿，只好在外边厅上用饭。”棉帘掀开，服务员引着一名达官、一位姑娘来到厅上。本来坐着的客商见到达官，纷纷起立。秦英豪并不理会，自顾自喝酒。只见那达官穿着酱色缎面狐皮外套，相貌甚是英俊。那姑娘相貌娇美，肤色白腻，双眼灵动，樱红小嘴，别说西北罕有如此佳丽，即令江南也是少有。她身穿一件葱绿织锦的皮袄，颜色鲜艳，但在她容光映照下，再灿烂的锦缎也显得黯然无色。

    众人眼前一亮，不由都有自惭形秽之感，有的讪讪地竟自退到了廊下，厅上顿时空出一大片地方来。

    服务员一叠连声叫唤，送饭送酒，极为殷勤。秦英豪听他叫喊酒菜时中气充沛，不觉留神，瞧他身形步法，显然是个会家子，又见他两边“太阳穴”微微凸出，竟然内功有颇深造诣，不由更加奇怪，暗想：“这批人必有重大图谋，左右闲着，就瞧瞧热闹，且看他们干的是好事还是歹事。不知跟这官儿有干系没有？”

    这一留神，不免向那达官与姑娘多看了几眼。那达官忽然一拍桌子，发作起来，指着秦英豪骂道：“你是什么东西？见了本官不回避也就罢了，贼眼还骨碌碌地瞧个不休。我看你粗手大脚，生成一副贼相，再瞧一眼，拿片子送到局子里去打你个皮开肉绽。”秦英豪低头喝酒，并不理会。那达官更加怒了，叫道：“你请安赔礼也不会么？这等大剌剌坐着。”

    那姑娘柔声劝说：“爸，你犯得着生这么大气？乡下人不懂规矩，也是有的。何必跟这些粗人一般见识？呐，喝了这杯吧。”说着将一杯酒递到他嘴边。那达官咕嘟一口喝干，似乎将怒气和酒吞服了，横了秦英豪一眼，见他低头不语，想是怕了，于是一边自斟自饮，一边跟女儿随意说笑，话中说的都是到了维京后，补上了官便怎样怎样，瞧神情似是一名赴京谋干的候补官员。

    说话间大门推开，飘进一片风雪，跟着又走进一位官员来。这人生得精瘦，肤色蜡黄，远没先前那官儿的气派十足。他笑着说：“人生何处不相逢，又和崎骏兄在这里撞见，真是巧之极矣！”说着抢过来与那名叫方崎骏的达官行礼相见。

    方家父女一起站起，方崎骏拱手说：“法官侯，幸会幸会！一起坐吧。”那法官侯谢了，坐在桌边。服务员添上杯筷，传酒呼菜。

    秦英豪心想：“连这个法官侯，一共是五个高手了。这姓方的父女看不出有什么武功。会不会大智若愚，竟让我走了眼呢？”想到此处，不禁暗自警戒，不敢向他们多瞧一眼。他一生所历风险多过常人百倍，此刻不由心惊：“这几人说不定是冲着我而来。他们成群结党，一起上来倒是难斗。不知前面是否更有高手？”只听法官侯与方崎骏高谈阔论，说的都是些**中升迁降谪的轶闻。

    廊下农民工和馄饨贩子却突然大声吵嚷起来。两人争的是世上有没有当真削铁如泥的宝剑宝刀。农民工说：“什么削铁如泥，胡吹大气！那宝刀也不过锋利点儿，当真就这么神？”馄饨贩子说：“你见过多少世面了？知道什么？宝刀就是宝刀，若不是怕吓坏了你，我就拿一口让你开开眼界。”农民工吵嚷：“你有宝刀？呸，做你的清秋大梦！有宝刀也不烧馄饨啦！只怕磨不利的钝柴刀、锈菜刀，倒有这么一把两把！”众人都大笑起来。

    馄饨贩子气呼呼地从担儿里取出一把刀来，绿皮鞘子金吞口，模样不凡。他唰地拔刀出鞘，寒光逼人，果然好一口利刃。众人都称赞：“好刀！”馄饨贩子拿起刀来，挥刀作势向农民工砍去。农民工抱头大叫：“我的妈呀！”急忙避开，众人又一阵哄笑。

    秦英豪瞧了二人神情，心想：“这两人果是一路。这么串戏，却不是演给我看的？”

    馄饨贩子说：“有上好菜刀柴刀，请借一把。”服务员应声走入后厨，取了一把菜刀出来。馄饨贩子说：“你拿稳了！”服务员将菜刀高高举起。馄饨贩子横刀挥去，铛的一声，菜刀断为两截，上半截当啷一声落地。众人齐声喝彩：“果是宝刀！”

    馄饨贩子得意洋洋，大声吹嘘，说他这柄刀如何厉害，如何名贵。廊下众人脸现仰慕之色，津津有味地听着。方崎骏听他说了一会，忍不住哼了一声，脸现不屑之色。

    法官侯说：“崎骏兄，这柄刀确也称得上个‘宝’字了，想不到贩夫走卒之徒居然身怀这等利器。”言下甚是可惜。方崎骏说：“利则利矣，宝则未必。”法官侯说：“崎骏兄此言差矣！你瞧此刀削铁如泥，世上哪里更有胜于此刀的呢？”方崎骏说：“你这就未免少见多怪了，方某就……”还待再说下去，方姑娘方玲忽然插口说：“爸，你喝多啦。快吃了饭去睡吧。”

    方崎骏笑着说：“嘿，女孩家就爱管你老子。”说着却真的要饭吃，不再喝酒。法官侯又说：“兄弟今日总算开了眼界，这等宝刀，兄台想来也是生平第一次见到。”方崎骏冷笑说：“胜于此刀十倍的也常常见到。”法官侯哈哈大笑说：“取笑，取笑！兄台是位文官，又见过什么宝刀来？”

    馄饨贩子听到了二人对答，大声说：“世上若有更胜得此刀的宝刀，我宁愿把头割下来送他！吹大气又谁不会啦？嘿，我说我儿子也要去维京做官哩。你们信不信啊？”众人忙喝道：“胡说，快闭嘴！”
content_en:
I saw two ladies in their thirties sitting in the middle of the room. Below them was an old woman, and to the left of the old woman sat another woman.The four women are all covered in silk and satin, and are adorned with jewels.Wu Guanting first nodded to the two ladies in the middle and saluted, then greeted the old woman and called: "Mom!" When the three ladies saw him coming in, they stood up early.

Wu Guanting's father Wu Sansheng was the former deputy prime minister of the cabinet, and his mother Chai Meiyan was revered as a queen.The eldest brother Wu Guanzhen serves as the commander-in-chief of the Northern War Zone, and is married to the third young master Lu Qingqing; the second brother Wu Guanlin is a Fujianese general, and is married to the eighth young master Lu Tingting.The third sister Wu Xi is the wife of the current queen Lu Jiacheng.Wu Sansheng's aunt Wu Xianhao is also the eighth first lady and the grandmother of the current prime minister.By this time Wu Sansheng and Wu Guanzhen had passed away.At that time, the Hengda Mansion was full of wealth and wealth, which was beyond the reach of the whole court.

The ladies sitting in the middle of the room are Wu Guanting's two sisters-in-law.The second sister-in-law, Lu Tingting, is well-spoken and good at serving others. She has been favored by her grandmother Wu Xianhao since she was a child. Every few days, she is summoned to Tongwan City to talk and relieve her boredom.The old woman was not young, but still quite beautiful. She was the wife of Wu Sansheng and the mother of Wu Guanting.Another noble lady is Wu Guanting’s wife Wang Huiwen.

Wu Guanting sat down on the chair at the west end and said, "Why don't the two sisters-in-law and mother rest at this late hour?" Chai Meiyan said, "Qingqing and Tingting were very happy when they heard that you had a child, and they were anxious to meet him." Wu Guanting glanced at Wang Huiwen, smiled slightly and said, "ThenThe woman is a figure in the world and has not yet learned the etiquette.I dare not let her come to see my sister-in-law and my mother." Lu Tingting said with a smile: "Isn't it good that the third child likes her?We don't want to see that woman either.Please ask someone to bring the two children to see her."

Wu Guanting was secretly proud, thinking that the Queen Mother would definitely like these two beautiful children when she saw them, so she ordered the nanny to go out and bring the two young gentlemen to her immediately.

Lu Tingting added: "I entered Tongwan City this morning. The Queen Mother said that the third child was sneaky. He gave birth to a child outside and did not find it for several years. He hid it from everyone. Be careful to skin you." Wu Guanting said with a smile: "I didn't know about these two children until last month."

After talking for a while, two nannies came in with the twin children.Wu Guanting ordered the two brothers to kowtow to Chai Meiyan, Lu Qingqing, Lu Tingting and Wang Huiwen.The two children were very obedient. Although they were sleepy-eyed, they still followed the instructions.

When several noble ladies saw that the two children looked the same, with round faces and delicate features, Lu Tingting clapped her hands and said with a smile, "Third brother, these children are from the same mold as you. You want to deny it, but you can't." Wang Huiwen was very angry about this matter, but these twins were really cute and couldn't help holding them in her arms, and they were really affectionate.Chai Meiyan, Lu Qingqing, and Lu Tingting each had gifts for meeting.The two nannies supported the child and kept thanking him.

Lu Qingqing, Lu Tingting and Wang Huiwen talked for a while and then left together.

Chai Meiyan called the nanny behind her and said, "Go and tell Yue that Taijun likes these children very much and will leave them to sleep with grandma tonight so that she doesn't have to wait for his two brothers." The nanny agreed.Chai Meiyan opened the drawer on the side of the table, took out a gold pot studded with gems, put it on the table, and said, "Take this pot of ginseng soup and give it to her, saying that Taijun will take good care of her children, so that she can rest assured!" Wu Guanting was holding a bowl of tea in his hand. When he heard this, his face changed drastically, his hands trembled, and a large amount of tea spilled out and splashed on his robe. He held the teacup in silence for a long time.The nanny took the gold pot, put it in a gold lacquer suitcase, and carried it away.Wu Guanting stretched out his right hand, as if to stop her, but seeing his mother's serious expression, he lowered his hand and stopped moving.

At this time, the two children were so tired that they were about to fall asleep and kept shouting: "Mom, mom, I want mom." Chai Meiyan said, "Don't make any noise, good kid, and follow grandma. Grandma will give you Tangtang and Cake Cake to eat." The two children cried, "No Tangtang, Cake Cake! No grandma! Mum!" Chai Meiyan's face sank, and she waved her hand to order the nanny to take the child away. With a wink, everyone left, leaving only Wu Guanting and her son in the room.

After a long while, the mother and son never exchanged a word. Chai Meiyan stared at her son.Wu Guanting looked away, not daring to meet his mother's eyes.

After a long time, Wu Guanting sighed and said, "Mom, why can't you tolerate her?" Chai Meiyan said, "Then there's no need to ask. This woman is a logistics worker, wields a knife and a spear, and is a master of martial arts. We have two young princes in our house, how can we live with such people? Have you forgotten about the famous prostitute in Kaifeng and the Kazakh girl? We will have trouble sleeping and eating if such a snake-like woman is between our elbows and armpits."

Wu Guanting thought about Liu Qiongyao and Gu Huien, and said dejectedly: "Mom's words are certainly good. I didn't want to take her into the house at first. I just sent someone to have a look and give her some money. Who knew she actually gave birth to two sons, who are my own flesh and blood, so that's different."

Chai Meiyan nodded and said, "You are already in your forties and have nothing to do, so it will be great to have these two children. If we raise these two children well, they will live a prosperous and prosperous life, and their mother will have peace of mind."

Wu Guanting pondered for a long time, then whispered: "What I mean is to send that woman to the border area and never see each other again. That's fine. I didn't expect you, mother..." Chai Meiyan's face darkened and she said, "It's useless for you to join the political secrets. You can't even think of the benefits. Her biological child is in our house, how can she not cause trouble? This kind of woman in the world can do anything if she sets her heart." Wu Guanting nodded.Chai Meiyan said: "You have done your best by ordering her to be buried with dignity..." Wu Guanting nodded again and agreed: "Yes!"

The more Min Jiageng listened outside the window, the more frightened he became. At first, he did not know what the words of his mother and son meant. But when he heard the words "a rich burial", he was shocked. He thought to himself: "It turns out that his mother and son are so vicious. They set up a conspiracy to take away the child and even tried to kill Sister Qing. This matterThe emergency is so extreme that we can't wait for a moment.Before the poisonous plan between the two of them is launched, we must immediately inform Sister Qing and rescue her from the house overnight." He walked out quietly and followed the original path back to the water pavilion. Fortunately, it was a quiet night and no one was walking in the garden, and the guard who was killed was not noticed yet.

Min Jiageng walked very fast, but he hesitated in his heart: "Sister Qing fell in love with Wu Guanting at first sight. The two of them met again after a long separation, and they were so passionate about each other. How could they be willing to escape from the house just after hearing my words? How can I convince her that she believes it?"

Before the plan was decided, before arriving at the water pavilion, I saw four more guards outside the door. I thought: "Humph, they have already laid down people to prevent her from escaping!" I didn't dare to be alarmed at that moment, so I walked around to the back of the pavilion, jumped over the pool of water outside the water pavilion, and saw that the lights in the pavilion were still on. I looked over and looked through the window crack, and I couldn't help but be stunned.

Yue Qing was seen lying on the ground, holding her belly and moaning, her hair was messy, her face was pale and green, and none of the nannies who were serving her were around.Min Jiageng suddenly realized: "Oh, no! It's too late after all!" He hurriedly pushed the window open and leaned over to look, and saw that she was breathing heavily and her eyes were red, as if they were about to bleed.

When Yue Qing saw Min Jiageng coming over, he said intermittently: "I...I...have a stomachache...Min...you..." After mentioning the word "you", he could no longer say anything.Min Jiageng whispered in her ear: "What did you eat just now?" Yue Qing looked at a gold pot studded with red and sapphires on the coffee table, but was speechless.

Min Jiageng recognized this golden pot. It was Chai Meiyan who filled the ginseng soup and ordered the nanny to give it to her to drink. He thought: "This old woman is very scheming. She wants to kill Sister Qing, but wants to keep the two children, so she called the children first and then brought the ginseng soup. Otherwise, Sister Qing would have given her son some ginseng soup when she got it and knew it was a tonic.Mouth." Then he thought: "Well, Wu Guanting's expression changed immediately when he saw the ginseng soup being poured out, and the tea was splashed on his clothes.He obviously knew that the ginseng soup was poisoned, but he didn't try to stop it, and he didn't come to save him afterward.Although he didn't poison it himself, he couldn't help but murmured: "What a vicious heart!"

Yue Qing struggled and said: "You... you... go and report... the minister... ask the doctor... ask the doctor to take a look..." Min Jiageng thought to himself: "If I want Wu Guanting to ask a doctor, I can only ask you to take more poison. Now I have to ask Shengsheng to try to rescue him." He lifted up a chair shawl, wrapped the golden pot containing the ginseng soup, and put it in his arms. Hearing that there was no movement outside the water pavilion, he picked up Yue Qing and jumped out of the window gently.Yue Qing was startled and shouted: "Min..." Min Jiageng hurriedly put his hand to her mouth and whispered: "Be silent, I will take you to see a doctor." Yue Qing said: "My child..."
